name: Empyrean Fortitude raises parry chance by 5% (#3098)
contract: Spell 706795 ships a native SPELL_AURA_MOD_PARRY_PERCENT effect (BasePoints 4 -> 5) plus a
SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL effect (EffectTriggerSpell 359019), gated by the spell_proc row
The parry% half of the tooltip is a plain native stat aura, so learning the passive alone should
raise parry_chance by 5. The Runic-Power-on-parry half needs an actual parried melee swing, which is
combat-RNG dependent even with Chance=100 (it still requires the defender to roll a parry); it is not
asserted deterministically here and is left as an observation.
